breakdown.description: The prompt describes a turbulent flow but sets the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero. This is physically incorrect and will prevent turbulence from developing correctly from the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that setting the inlet turbulent kinetic energy (k) and specific dissipation rate (omega) to zero was physically incorrect for a turbulent flow simulation. Instead of using zero, it calculated and set non-zero, physically plausible values for both k (uniform 1.5) and omega (uniform 447.2), thus resolving the inconsistency.
